title: International Organizations and U.S. Power — Final 27-Object Registry
purpose: Expose the reconciled legal identity, United States relationship, power bundle, money route, exit state, operating owner and bypass ruling for 27 international institutional objects without flattening their legal forms or clocks.
scope_boundary: This is a United States relationship and control map, not a complete history of every organization. Organizations, organs, programmes, treaty regimes, forums, facilities and accords remain separately typed. Institution-specific percentages use different denominators and cannot be consolidated. Exit, defunding, internal refit, parallel doctrine, shared machinery, resource migration, default use and residual-incumbent status remain separate states.
claim_limit: Percentages are institution-specific and cannot be consolidated. Exit, defunding, internal refit, parallel doctrine, shared machinery, resource migration, default use and residual-incumbent status are separate clocks.

records.name: United Nations
records.us_relationship: founding Charter Member, General Assembly voter, P5 veto holder, host and assessed contributor
records.money: regular and peacekeeping assessments; voluntary funds separate
records.exit: no Charter withdrawal clause; no U.S. core exit directed
records.operating_owner: principal organs, Secretariat and Member States by function

bypass.ruling: core retained

records.name: UN Human Rights Council
records.us_relationship: nonparticipating former/electable Council participant; no separate treaty membership
records.money: dedicated or attributed UN funding withheld
records.exit: nonparticipation, not UN withdrawal
records.operating_owner: Council, OHCHR support and elected members

bypass.ruling: no successor human-rights machinery

records.name: UNRWA
records.us_relationship: former major voluntary donor, not member
records.money: U.S. contributions prohibited; mandate and other funding continue
records.exit: no separate state membership
records.operating_owner: UNRWA Commissioner-General, staff and field network

bypass.ruling: no proved transfer of mandate, records or field network

records.name: NATO
records.us_relationship: founding Party, depositary and leading command contributor
records.money: 14.9039% 2026-2027 common-cost share; national defence spending separate
records.exit: Article 13 one year; U.S. domestic statute requires Senate or Congress route
records.operating_owner: North Atlantic Council, command structure and national authorities

bypass.ruling: European JFC shift inside NATO; no successor

records.name: Organization of American States
records.us_relationship: founding Member, one vote, Washington host and dominant assessed contributor
records.money: 49.990% 2026 quota; delayed 2025 payment later paid
records.exit: Article 143 two years after notice with obligations fulfilled
records.operating_owner: General Assembly, Permanent Council, Secretariat and autonomous organs

bypass.ruling: core retained

records.name: International Atomic Energy Agency
records.us_relationship: initial Member, continuous Board representation in practice and depositary
records.money: 25.005% 2026 scale; extra-budgetary funds separate
records.exit: Statute withdrawal on notice; safeguards agreements remain instrument-specific
records.operating_owner: Board, Secretariat, inspectors and underlying safeguards agreements

bypass.ruling: no successor verification machinery

records.name: Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons
records.us_relationship: State Party and Executive Council participant
records.money: assessed contribution plus voluntary support
records.exit: CWC extraordinary-events withdrawal with 90-day notice and Security Council notice
records.operating_owner: Conference, Executive Council, Technical Secretariat and national authorities

bypass.ruling: no replacement inspectorate

records.name: INTERPOL
records.us_relationship: Member through INTERPOL Washington National Central Bureau
records.money: statutory contributions and voluntary/project funding
records.exit: Constitution does not supply a simple notice clause; membership action follows internal rules
records.operating_owner: General Secretariat, Commission for Control of Files and national police

bypass.ruling: no supranational arrest power and no successor

records.name: World Health Organization
records.us_relationship: executive claims exit complete; WHO still treated U.S. as Member in arrears in May 2026
records.money: funding ended by U.S.; WHO ledger showed large unpaid assessments
records.exit: stated effective Jan. 22, 2026; legal and financial books unresolved
records.operating_owner: Health Assembly, Executive Board, Secretariat, Member States and IHR network

bypass.ruling: bilateral aid default changed; universal WHO functions retained

records.name: UNESCO
records.us_relationship: Member until Dec. 31, 2026 under notice
records.money: membership assessment ends after effective withdrawal; other instruments separate
records.exit: effective Dec. 31, 2026
records.operating_owner: General Conference, Executive Board, Secretariat and treaty bodies

bypass.ruling: no general successor; conventions survive unless separately ended

records.name: International Monetary Fund
records.us_relationship: founding Member and largest shareholder
records.money: quota, NAB and bilateral borrowing participation
records.exit: written notice effective on receipt; accounts settled
records.operating_owner: Board of Governors, Executive Board, Managing Director and member implementation

bypass.ruling: strong steering, no successor fund

records.name: World Bank Group
records.us_relationship: largest shareholder across IBRD, IDA, IFC, MIGA and one ICSID representative
records.money: separate capital, market borrowing, replenishment, premiums and fees by entity
records.exit: five entity-specific routes and surviving liabilities
records.operating_owner: each legal entity's board, management, agreements and remedy system

bypass.ruling: mission and allocation pressure inside incumbents

records.name: World Trade Organization
records.us_relationship: founding Member and reform proponent
records.money: assessment based mainly on trade share; 2023 U.S. share 11.667% is last recovered
records.exit: Article XV six months
records.operating_owner: Ministerial/General Council, specialized councils, committees and DSB

bypass.ruling: MPIA default for participating non-U.S. Members only; core WTO retained

records.name: OECD
records.us_relationship: founding Member, one Council vote and largest Part I contributor
records.money: 18% of 2026 Part I budget
records.exit: 12 months notice to France
records.operating_owner: Council, committees, Secretariat, instrument parties and national authorities

bypass.ruling: U.S. side-by-side tax regime embedded in incumbent machinery

records.name: Bank for International Settlements
records.us_relationship: Federal Reserve Board is Member; sovereign U.S. is not direct Member
records.money: capital, reserves and banking business; no sovereign assessment
records.exit: no simple public voluntary Member-central-bank clause recovered
records.operating_owner: General Meeting, Board, Management, bank and hosted committees

bypass.ruling: standards require domestic adoption

records.name: Group of Seven
records.us_relationship: participant and rotating presidency holder
records.money: host and national costs; no assessed budget
records.exit: political participation; no treaty clause
records.operating_owner: national governments and named downstream institutions

bypass.ruling: does not inherit implementation authority

records.name: Group of Twenty
records.us_relationship: Member and 2026 presidency
records.money: national presidency costs; no standing assessed budget
records.exit: political participation; no treaty clause
records.operating_owner: national governments, invited institutions and competent authorities

bypass.ruling: upstream control plane, not downstream owner

records.name: International Civil Aviation Organization
records.us_relationship: founding Contracting State, Council Part I Member and depositary
records.money: 21.69% 2026-2028 assessment scale
records.exit: Article 95 one year after notice to U.S. Government
records.operating_owner: Assembly, Council, Secretariat and national aviation authorities

bypass.ruling: national differences valve; standards/audit record retained

records.name: International Maritime Organization
records.us_relationship: active Member and 2026-2027 Category A Council Member
records.money: tonnage-based assessment; exact 2026 U.S. amount not recovered
records.exit: Article 78 twelve months; administered treaties separate
records.operating_owner: Assembly, Council, committees, treaty parties and flag/port/coastal States

bypass.ruling: decentralized enforcement, no successor treaty book

records.name: International Telecommunication Union
records.us_relationship: active Member, 2023-2026 Council State and largest 2026 Member-State contributor
records.money: 35 units, CHF11.1m in 2026
records.exit: Article 57 one year after simultaneous Constitution/Convention notice
records.operating_owner: Plenipotentiary, Council, bureaux, RRB and national regulators

bypass.ruling: binding spectrum record plus voluntary standards

records.name: World Intellectual Property Organization
records.us_relationship: active Member, treaty party, service user and USPTO-led participant
records.money: about 96% user-fee funded; U.S. annual assessment CHF1,139,475
records.exit: WIPO Convention six months; each administered treaty separate
records.operating_owner: assemblies, International Bureau and national/regional offices

bypass.ruling: Madrid e-Filing became U.S. outbound default toward WIPO

records.name: CERN
records.us_relationship: non-Member LHC and HL-LHC observer and contractual project partner
records.money: project grants and in-kind support; no U.S. Member assessment
records.exit: agreement/project termination, not Member withdrawal
records.operating_owner: CERN Council/laboratory and experiment collaborations

bypass.ruling: no substitute facility or data route

records.name: ITER
records.us_relationship: founding Member, Council participant and Domestic Agency contributor
records.money: $6.5bn U.S. project baseline; cash and in-kind; FY2026 request not treated as enacted
records.exit: Article 26; construction, decommissioning and accrued rights survive
records.operating_owner: ITER Organization, Council, Domestic Agencies and French nuclear regulator

bypass.ruling: 2026 hardware and Council operation proved

records.name: Paris Agreement
records.us_relationship: former Party after second withdrawal
records.money: U.S. climate-finance commitments revoked; treaty finance continues for others
records.exit: effective Jan. 27, 2026; parent UNFCCC exit effective Feb. 27, 2027
records.operating_owner: CMA/COP, UNFCCC Secretariat, registries and Parties

bypass.ruling: policy reversal, no replacement climate governance

records.name: Kyoto Vision for a Golden Age of Science
records.us_relationship: U.S.-led declaration endorsed by 17 countries
records.money: no common fund or assessment
records.exit: not a membership treaty
records.operating_owner: each national government

bypass.ruling: no shared machinery or resource migration

records.name: Artemis Accords
records.us_relationship: founding signatory and NASA/State co-lead
records.money: no common assessed budget; missions and bilateral agreements separate
records.exit: voluntary political commitment; no treaty withdrawal clause
records.operating_owner: signatory governments, NASA/national agencies and separate mission agreements

bypass.ruling: 76-signatory norm incubator nested in existing space treaties

records.name: Board of Peace
records.us_relationship: founding Member and depositary; President is inaugural Chairman and U.S. representative
records.money: voluntary funding and Board vehicles; $1bn cash affects membership term; pledges not treated as disbursement
records.exit: immediate Member withdrawal by notice to Chairman; organization subject to Chairman renewal/dissolution rules
records.operating_owner: Board, Chairman, Executive Board, Gaza entities, participating States and Security Council renewal gate

bypass.ruling: real new machinery; September 2026 Gaza field handoff incomplete
